title: 5 Years Back
author: Seth Abstract
text:
As far as I can tell
The sun shines on me and
The path I walk is a happy one

But every now and then

The hands of what could’ve been,
Better men, grab and drag my feet
Slowly pulling me down

down

title: Holy War
author: Seth Abstract
text:
It's been so damn dark
Crusading these rolling hills.
Zeus, you lazy bitch

title: Bang
author: Seth Abstract
text:
Tick Tock
Tick Tock
Dancing to the clock

Atoms Move
Women Groove
Laws have nothing to prove

Our lives
Set paths
Byproduct of chaotic math

Bound Slaves
Feel Pain
Trying not to go insane

Reset
The Sand
It falls the same

Boom went a clock
So we all went
Tick Tock

title: Snake Eyes
author: Seth Abstract
text:
I’m alone
On my bed
Nothing happens
Then suddenly

The vortex of the void vehemently pulls me panicking and praying into its inky interior where darkness devours all doors leaving me stranded and shaking watching galaxies grinning and growing while capillaries are crushed by the chill leaving me crippled for the Reaper to run ragged and if I lay down it’s over, I never would but I see how you could

Then god flicks the circuit breaker
The lights come on
And I'm dancing in the shower
Singing my favorite songs

Wondering what the hell happened
The darkness only a dim memory
The pain washing down the drain
While my eyes crinkle with glee

Sometimes I swear god is just
Throwing dice at the wall
And seeing what sticks

title: Bodies
author: Seth Abstract
text:
I’m drowning in a sea of long dead corpses
Gasping for my own body to come save me
I push aside a father, a teacher, a fossilized poet
But I remain hidden in the rot

title: The American Dream
author: Seth Abstract
text:
I stare out the window
Watching the sun shine on the best of us
They hold hands in an abundance of life
Piles of food, mountains of gold
One day I’ll join them
I just need to work harder
I raise mangled and bloody stumps
And beat the glass

title: Ocean Waves Peel Back
author: Seth Abstract
text:
Ocean waves peel back,
Unmasking angel winged fish
Floating to new blues.

title: At Last! The Green Plains
author: Seth Abstract
text:
At last! The green plains,
Light has never seemed so bright!
Abandon all hope!

title: Once upon a time
author: Seth Abstract
text:
There was a feast to be had
For all the beasts of the land!

From the pigs singing in mud,
To the cows chewing their cud,

From the birds spinning in the sky,
To the cats sleeping side by side,

From the wolves howling out names,
To the humans playing their silly little games.

The dinner bell rings and
They all sit down to eat.
Around the table
At their great big feast!

So begins the gnashing of teeth.
The ripping of bloody meat.

Their sweating pores dripping
As they crave more and more.

Consuming the dead, to power
the living, until they are dead.

Their oily hairs trembling and falling
As slick red stink drips down chins.

The great wide eyes of the beasts
Bulging in their communion.

Matter absorbing matter.
Mechanical cannibalism.

Them all terrifying, terrible, unpredictable
Clumps of unyielding horror.

Them all brothers in
Unholy pain.

title: So They All
author: Seth Abstract
text:
Breathe slow
through your
nose.
there is no art
there is no words
there is no film
Ever made
by anything more
than a
man.
Futile man
slinging paint at
the abyss,
Coloring his honest
to God life as clear
as dirt can be
made.
A curse and a prayer,
never able to see if
anything will be
Spared.

title: I Don’t Understand
author: Seth Abstract
text:
Two hands of a clock
Tick and tock
Locked in a rhythm
Of beats and blocks
One carries the burden
The other the fox
Hear the chimes of touch
As sunken eyes swap
Minutes fall back
The hands swinging with their luck
Watching each other
One always yelling FUCK

title: Morning Light
author: Seth Abstract
text:
The air pressed to dance
By small bird hands. Notes crashing
On a poor owl's door.
